finding: The study found a 2.08% prevalence of HCV genotype 4 among pregnant women in Egypt and a 12.5% vertical transmission rate among HCV-positive mothers, suggesting that screening women with surgical interventions or CS history may prevent HCV mother-to-child transmission.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was found to be associated with a higher risk of HCV vertical transmission in Egypt, suggesting the need for ethical justification of CS to decrease global HCV transmission.
